vt:vector.vt:lpstr: Table Name : t_lms_financial_period_config Description: This table contains information of financial period.
Table Name : t_lms_user_master Description: t_lms_user_master table contain the details of system user.
Table Name : t_lms_role Description: t_lms_role table contain the name of different role for system.
Table Name : t_lms_user_role Description: t_lms_user_role table contain the detail of provided roles to user in system.
Table Name : t_lms_position Description: t_lms_position table contain the name of different position in company.
Table Name : t_lms_user_position Description: t_lms_user_position table contain the details of assigned position to user in company.
Table Name : t_lms_leave_type Description: t_lms_leave_type table contain the different type of leaves.
Table Name : t_lms_position_leave Description: t_lms_position_leave table contain the detail of allowed leave to different position user.
Table Name : t_lms_leave_incur Description: t_lms_leave_incur table contain the monthly increase applicable leave.
Table Name : t_lms_leave_deduct Description: t_lms_leave_deduct table contain the deducted approved no of leave from total credited user leave.
Table Name : t_lms_carry_forward_audit Description: t_lms_carry_forward_audit table contain detail of leave carry forward in next month/year.
Table Name : t_lms_leave_request Description: t_lms_ leave_request table contain the details of user applied leave request and that detail.
Table Name : t_lms_leave_email_token Description: t_lms_leave_email_token table contain the data of generated email token, which are send to manager / approver for perform action on it.
Table Name : t_lms_manage_holiday Description: t_lms_manage_holiday table contain the data of current year holidays, it is maintained by system administrator.
